range_convention: [start,end) file offsets into the UNPACKED DAVE.EXE image

unpacked_original.sha1_provenance: Matches an independently published UNLZEXE-decompressed DAVE.EXE (Internet Archive item "Dangerous Dave (LZW decompressed)") byte-for-byte, giving external cross-validation beyond internal self-consistency.

packed_original.note: Final oracle for the packed distribution file; see docs/build-reconstruction.md for why unpacked-image matching is tracked as a separate, prerequisite level.

regions.description: The 14-word (28-byte) MZ header proper: e_magic, e_cblp, e_cp, e_crlc, e_cparhdr, e_minalloc, e_maxalloc, e_ss, e_sp, e_csum, e_ip, e_cs, e_lfarlc, e_ovno.
27 far-pointer relocation entries (4 bytes each: offset, segment), reconstructed by tools/lzexe_unpack.py from LZEXE's packed relocation encoding. e_crlc=27, e_lfarlc=28.
Zero-filled padding from the end of the relocation table to the end of the MZ header area (e_cparhdr=32 paragraphs = 512 bytes). Verified all-zero.

regions.library: Borland Turbo C++ 1.00 runtime (small memory model)
regions.description: The program's C startup module (crt0-equivalent): sets up DS/ES, computes heap/stack, calls _main, calls _exit. Entry point CS:IP = 0000:0000 lands here. Identified by tools/recover_startup_binding.py: comparing this region's 569 bytes against C0S.OBJ's _TEXT segment, every one of the 35 differing bytes falls exactly on a fixup (relocation) location recorded in C0S.OBJ's own FIXUPP records (0 unexplained diffs) -- the small memory model is the unique model for which this holds (all other models leave dozens of unexplained diffs). See docs/startup-binding-evidence.json.
regions.matching_status_note: All non-fixup bytes are byte-identical to the unmodified library object. Fixup-target bytes (real addresses of _DATA/_BSS/_main/_exit/etc., patched in by the linker) are not yet independently re-derived -- that requires a full link-layout reconstruction (segment ordering, sizes) which has not been attempted yet. This is a genuine, falsifiable match (see tools/recover_startup_binding.py's per-model comparison), not a raw copy relabeled.
